Maya: Heads-up — backlog triage for Optimize toolkit this Thu 11am PT. Need to pick which items enter sprint: batching heuristics, prefix KV cache UX, quantized fallback policy, eval-triggered alerts. Quick votes?

Liam: +1 to make eval-alerts MVP gated. Customers keep asking for regressions detection.

Sofia: I want a small 'mobile' slice: short-context batching + aggressive quant profiles. Needs clear acceptance criteria.

Ethan: Ops: dedicated quant fallbacks increase infra variance. Need SLO for p99 latency when falling back.

Ravi: Suggest prioritizing batching heuristics and cache UX first — biggest cost wins for early pilots.

Maya: Proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
1) batching heuristics reduce per-token cost by >=15% on representative mobile traces,
2) prefix caching improves median latency by <=10ms for warm prefixes,
3) quantized fallback yields <5% quality regression on curated prompt set (automated metric + human spot-check),
4) eval-triggered alerts detect >=95% of regression-class signals with <2 false positives/day.

Sofia: can we include a small test harness for customer vignette? otherwise quality numbers are meaningless.

Ethan: note from infra: fallback path must be automatic and observable. We'll need a flag: `quant.fallback=enabled` and metrics: `fallback_rate`, `p99_latency`, `cost_delta`.

Liam: +1 to observability. Also add runbook step: if `fallback_rate > 3%` sustained for 1h, auto-scale or roll back the quant profile.

Sofia: on evaluation, add step to run human-sample check for 100 examples before GA.

devbot: Reminder: sprint-planning slot booked 2024-04-04T18:00Z 

Maya: ok action list: (1) Product to finalize acceptance criteria (Sofia + Maya) by Mon, (2) Eng to prototype batching heuristics (Ethan + Ravi) by mid-sprint, (3) Infra to spec metrics and flags (Ethan) by EOD Fri, (4) AE to provide 2 customer vignette datasets (Liam) by Tue. :thumbsup:

Ravi: Will add quick perf-run script and upload traces to /tmp/optimize-traces.

Liam: Thanks — I'll flag two pilot customers who care about mobile cost.

Maya: Thanks all — we'll lock scope after acceptance criteria update.
